'''Mai''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Surviving the [[Third Jedi Purge|Jedi Purge]], Mai traveled to the [[Hidden Temple|Hidden Jedi Temple]] and lived around [[130 ABY]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master attended to [[Azlyn Rae]] as [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Shado Vao]] met with the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Legacy 25" />

When [[Jariah Syn]] recognized Master [[Rasi Tuum]], the Jedi who [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Zareb Syn|father]], he slowly backed away from the group. Worried, Master Mai followed him and asked if he was ill. Syn yelled at Mai to get away from him and punched Mai, who was rendered unconsciousness.<ref name="Legacy 25" />
